_comment: Read by `aiq-lean source staging dev/experimental-root-status.json --compile` (previously scripts/check_experimental_root_status.py). The status vocabulary, the aggregate target, and the empty-on-success rule are policy fields here; the mechanism is in the installed package.
policy: This registry records compiler status only. The checker compiles every active root and then runs lake build DavisKahan.Experimental, so omitted failures cannot be certified by an empty registry. Emptied 2026-07-31: the single parked root, DavisKahan/Experimental/Sources/DavisKahan1970/Section8/All.lean, compiles on its own and the four modules its reason named as blockers are gone from that path -- three no longer exist (Core.CompatibilitySinTwoTheta, GraphSubspace, Sylvester.Resolvent) and Ideals.Symmetric compiles. The Contour.integral / IsClosed / Rectifiable API it waited on is still absent from the repository, Mathlib and vendored Spectra; what changed is that nothing on this path calls it any more. Re-park by adding a root here if that stops being true.
